g.text: re-read everything: overview (default) | all of it as
state, battery, cleaning settings, room selection
totals, daily activity and a timeline of the last n runs
room, position and dock distance with a mini map
save the map image (default map.png) and preview it
floor tree with rooms | switch active floor
rooms on the active floor (selected highlighted)
add rooms by (partial) name, list number or segment id
all settable options, current value highlighted
show options or set suction / water flow / mop route
show or set high-level cleaning mode (if supported)
clean selected rooms (or whole floor if none selected):
zone clean (mm, see where) with current passes: mini
drive to a point (mm, see where): mini map, asks first
spot clean around the robot, asks first
pause / continue / stop in place (all ask first; -y
end the clean and return to base, asks first
show or set the voice volume
show or switch do not disturb / child lock / LED
clear the current robot or dock error (says which first)
list resettable parts | reset a wear counter after
send any command (no safety checks), shows the answer as
list all known commands, optionally filtered
clear screen and scrollback, then show banner and
fresh connections to the robot (done automatically after
Display commands accept raw for the plain output, e.g. 'status raw', 'help raw'.
Tab completes commands and their arguments; ↑/↓ and Ctrl+R search the history, kept across
Ctrl+C cancels a running command; at the prompt it quits.
